scope: Choose one common lambda from seed0 SGD-to-SGD sweep, then freeze it across four EWC variants and seeds0/1/2
average_definition: A2 = (a21 + a22) / 2, evaluated after the second task; not a22 alone
geometric_consistency: Check raw-Fisher-weighted drift reduction against lambda0; if measured accuracy protection conflicts with unreduced weighted drift, record evidence and resolve interpretation before locking lambda. Total unweighted Q/V norm need not strictly decrease.
no_candidate_policy: Enter refinement_required and execute the authorized adaptive lambda search in refinement_policy.json; keep the four-row reruns gated. Do not choose lambda0, relax thresholds, change lr or treat divergence as success. Report no qualifying range only when evidence-supported refinement/expansion is exhausted.
post_selection: Save SELECTION.json before supplementary formal training; no per-row/per-seed retuning
seed0_selection_bias: Seed0 is used for selection; rerunning seed0 is repeatability checking, not an independent validation seed. Report seed1/2 separately as out-of-selection seeds.
selection_pool: Union of valid completed initial-sweep and completed adaptive-refinement points, with immutable source receipts
required_points_observed_scope: 14 is the initial sweep requirement, not a cap on the subsequent adaptive search; every dispatched refinement round must have validated terminal outcomes before its selection decision
